operations.description: Deletes a note. Caller must have the `OWNER` role on the note to delete. Deleting a note removes the resource immediately and cannot be undone. Any collaborators will lose access to the note.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] keep notes delete [PATH]  [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Lists notes. Every list call returns a page of results with `page_size` as the upper bound of returned items. A `page_size` of zero allows the server to choose the upper bound. The ListNotesResponse contains at most `page_size` entries. If there are more things left to list, it provides a `next_page_token` value. (Page tokens are opaque values.) To get the next page of results, copy the result's `next_page_token` into the next request's `page_token`. Repeat until the `next_page_token` returned with a page of results is empty. ListNotes return consistent results in the face of concurrent changes, or signals that it cannot with an ABORTED error.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] keep notes list [PATH] notes [PARAMS] access alt callback fields filter key oauth page pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] attachment list note notes permission response section

operations.description: Creates one or more permissions on the note. Only permissions with the `WRITER` role may be created. If adding any permission fails, then the entire request fails and no changes are made.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] keep notes permissions batch create [PATH] permissions batch create [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] batch create family group permission permissions request response user

operations.description: Deletes one or more permissions on the note. The specified entities will immediately lose access. A permission with the `OWNER` role can't be removed. If removing a permission fails, then the entire request fails and no changes are made. Returns a 400 bad request error if a specified permission does not exist on the note.
